'''Martin Oeggerli''' (born 7 March 1974), known professionally as '''Micronaut''', is a [[Switzerland|Swiss]] photographer specializing in scientific [[microscopy]] and fine art.<ref name=natgeo/>

==Biography==
Oeggerli studied biology at the [[University of Basel]]<ref name=natgeo>{{cite web|url=http://www.nationalgeographic.com/contributors/o/photographer-martin-oeggerli/|title=Martin Oeggerli|publisher=National Geographic|url-status=dead|archive-date=2016-09-18|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160918031205/http://www.nationalgeographic.com/contributors/o/photographer-martin-oeggerli/}}</ref> from 1994 to 2000 and obtained his diploma in 2002 under David G. Senn.{{cn|date=June 2026}} In 2005, he obtained his PhD in molecular pathology under Guido Sauter at the University of Basel.<ref>{{Cite thesis |title=E2F3 is responsible for frequent amplification of 6p22.3 in human bladder cancer |url=http://edoc.unibas.ch/diss/DissB_7913 |publisher=University_of_Basel |date=2007 |doi=10.5451/unibas-004237488|type=Thesis |first=Martin |last=Oeggerli}}</ref> Since 2006, he has been working in the research department of the [[University Hospital of Basel]] as part of a project funded by the [[Swiss National Science Foundation]] and is also a consultant to a laboratory specializing in scanning electron microscopy (PTU GmbH).{{cn|date=June 2026}}

==Awards==
* 2006: Bilder der Forschung - 3rd prize<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.focus.de/wissen/natur/die-preisgekroenten-bilder-2006-fotowettbewerb_id_1503073.html|title=Fotowettbewerb - Preisgekrönte Wissenschaftsfotos 200|publisher=Focus|date=2006-11-07|language=de|access-date=2026-06-25}}</ref><ref name=natgeo/>
* 2008: Bilder der Forschung - 1st and 2nd prize<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.focus.de/wissen/natur/beste-wissenschaftsbilder-praemiert-bilder-der-forschung-2008_id_2526065.html|title=„Bilder der Forschung 2008“: Beste Wissenschaftsbilder prämiert|publisher=Focus|date=2008-09-18|last=Müller|first=Wolfgang|access-date=2026-06-25|language=de}}</ref><ref name=natgeo/>
* 2008: ''[[The EMBO Journal]]'' Best Scientific Cover Image - 1st prize<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/climate-solutions/into-the-microscopic/656128|title=Into the microscopic|publisher=SwissInfo.ch|date=2008-05-28|access-date=2026-06-25}}</ref>
* 2009: Bilder der Forschung - 3rd prize<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.focus.de/wissen/natur/die-siegerfotos-2009-2008-und-2007-bilder-der-forschung_id_1500394.html|title=Bilder der Forschung - Die Siegerfotos 2009, 2008 und 2007|publisher=Focus|date=2009-05-04|access-date=2026-06-25|language=de}}</ref><ref name=natgeo/>
* 2009: Bild der Wissenschaft German Prize for Scientific Photography - 1st prize<ref>{{cite web|url=https://wissenschaft.de/artikel/5-sieger-aus-3-laendern/|title=5 sieger aus 3 ländern|publisher=Bild der Wissenschaft|date=2010-01-19|access-date=2026-06-25|language=es}}</ref><ref name=natgeo/>
* 2010: [[International Photography Awards]] - 2nd prize category 'Special: Micro'<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.photoawards.com/winner/?compName=IPA+2010|title=IPA 2010 top photographers of the year|publisher=International Photography Awards|date=2010|access-date=2026-03-24}}</ref><ref name=natgeo/>
* 2010: ''[[The EMBO Journal]]'' Best Scientific Cover Image - 1st prize<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/archive-science/photographer-reveals-the-secret-life-of-pollen/8782988|title=Photographer reveals the secret life of pollen|last=Leybold-Johnson|first=Isobel|publisher=SwissInfo.ch|date=2010-05-05|access-date=2026-06-25}}</ref>
* 2011: Bild der Wissenschaft German Prize for Scientific Photography - 1st prize<ref>{{cite web|url=https://wissenschaft.de/artikel/deutscher-preis-fuer-wissenschaftsfotografie-vergebe/|title=deutscher preis für wissenschaftsfotografie vergeben|publisher=Bild der Wissenschaft|date=2011-09-23|access-date=2026-06-25|language=de}}</ref><ref name=natgeo/>
* 2011: [[International Photography Awards]] - 1st and 2nd prize category 'Special: Micro'<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.photoawards.com/winner/?compName=IPA+2011|title=IPA 2011 top photographers of the year|publisher=International Photography Awards|date=2011|access-date=2026-03-24}}</ref>
* 2022: [[Lennart Nilsson Award]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://news.ki.se/lennart-nilsson-award-2022-is-awarded-to-martin-oeggerli|title=Lennart Nilsson Award 2022 is awarded to Martin Oeggerli|date=2022-06-23|publisher=Karolinska Institutet|access-date=2026-06-24}}</ref>
